beats.headline: Shares Rise 3.24% Following 8-K and 10-Q Filings
beats.explanation: Apple gained 3.24% to close at $280.14 on 1.9x average volume following an 8-K filed on April 30 and a 10-Q filed on May 1. The upward move was partly shared with competitor INTC, which advanced 5.44%, while supplier QCOM moved in the opposite direction, declining 1.43%.

beats.headline: Shares Drop 3.65% Amid Broad Tech Pullback
beats.explanation: No company-specific news accompanied Apple's 3.65% drop from $301.54 to $290.55. The decline was shared with peer companies, including supplier QCOM, which fell 5.67%, and competitors INTC and MSFT, which lost 2.13% and 2.02%, respectively.

beats.headline: Stock Drops 6.12% Without Company-Specific News
beats.explanation: No company-specific news accompanied Apple's 6.12% drop to $275.15 on 2.6x its typical volume. The decline was shared with competitor MSFT, which declined 3.46%, and supplier CRUS, which fell 2.34%, though supplier QCOM moved the other way with a 3.79% gain.

beats.headline: Shares Rebound 3.14% on Heavy Trading Volume
beats.explanation: Apple rebounded 3.14% to $283.78 on volume reaching 6.3x its 30-day average without any company-specific news. The gain was shared with competitor MSFT, which climbed 5.71%, while suppliers QCOM and CRUS fell 7.57% and 4.86%, respectively.

beats.headline: Apple Gains 4.84% Diverging from Suppliers
beats.explanation: Apple rose 4.84% to finish at $308.63 with no company-specific news released. The move was company-specific, as competitor MSFT rose only 1.62% while suppliers QCOM and TSM dropped 3.12% and 2.27%, respectively.

beats.headline: Stock Advances 4.01% Alongside Tech Peers
beats.explanation: Apple climbed 4.01% from $314.86 to $327.50 without company-specific news. The advance was shared with customer GOOGL, which rose 3.17%, and competitor MSFT, which added 2.78%, while competitor INTC dropped 4.43%.

beats.headline: Shares Gain 3.53% as Chip Peers Diverge
beats.explanation: No company-specific news was reported as Apple rose 3.53% to close at $333.02. The gain was company-specific relative to semiconductor peers, as suppliers TSM and QCOM retreated 2.93% and 2.42%, and competitor INTC slumped 7.89%.

beats.headline: Stock Drops 7.35% Following 8-K and 10-Q Filings
beats.explanation: Apple plunged 7.35% to $308.91 on 3.2x normal volume following its July 30 8-K and July 31 10-Q filings. The drop was company-specific, occurring while customer GOOGL gained 6.73% and competitor MSFT climbed 3.02%.

beats.headline: Apple Climbs 3.56% as Supplier CRUS Surges
beats.explanation: Apple rose 3.56% to $326.57 without company-specific announcements. The rally was shared with supplier CRUS, which jumped 5.20%, even as competitor INTC declined 5.57% and supplier TSM dropped 1.68%.

arc: Between May and September 2026, Apple traded between a low of $275.15 and a high of $333.02, marked by high volatility around official regulatory disclosure periods. The two most pronounced company-specific catalysts were its quarterly reporting periods: an 8-K and 10-Q filing cycle around May 1 that lifted shares 3.24% to $280.14, and another filing cycle around July 31 that triggered a sharp 7.35% pullback to $308.91 on heavy volume. Outside of these filing windows, Apple demonstrated frequent divergence from its semiconductor supply chain partners such as TSM and QCOM, often rallying on days when chip suppliers declined, while intermittently moving in tandem with large platform peers like Microsoft and Alphabet.
